claims.text: A machine-learning approach can accurately predict melting temperatures of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict enthalpies of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict entropies of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict volume changes at melting for high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict liquid-phase thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The proposed machine-learning approach can predict these thermodynamic properties efficiently relative to current experimental and theoretical methods.
The proposed approach is applicable across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning algorithms can use relationships among alloy composition, processing conditions, and resulting thermodynamic properties to generate predictions.
The performance of the proposed approach is limited by the quality of its training data.

Complex relationships among alloy composition, processing conditions, and thermodynamic properties limit the performance of the proposed approach.
